args.evidence: The not_null_stg_lineitem_extended_price test failed with 29,778 nulls. In stg_lineitem, extended_price was defined as `case when l_returnflag = 'N' then l_extendedprice end`, which yields NULL for rows where return_flag != 'N'. The raw source column l_extendedprice is never null, so the nulls are introduced by the model. Changing the expression to directly select l_extendedprice removes the unintended nulls and all checks now pass.
